item.title: ZoomerMedia Launches New Multicultural Streaming Video Platform Dekho Canada
item.description: ZoomerMedia Limited (TSXV: ZUM) announces the launch of "Dekho Canada", a new multilingual video streaming platform for Canadians to access and stream content from Canada's Sikh, Hindu, Islamic, and Christian communities.

item.title: Follow One Woman’s Year Long Anti-Aging Quest in Hack Your Age
item.description: Can you hack your age to live a longer, healthier life? In this compelling Canadian documentary, 55-year-old Deedee, attempts to do so and tells us more about her experience and the results in this Q&A.

item.title: Bob Marley’s Granddaughter Goes Reaching For Zion
item.description: Reaching For Zion follows Bob Marley's granddaughter, Donisha Prendergast, on a powerful, international quest to understand the roots of her grandfather’s extraordinary legacy and his unlikely connection to Judaism.

item.title: Creature Comfort Docu-Series Explores How Pets Can Help Us Age Better
item.description: The Canadian docu-series Creature Comfort explores the crucial roles animals and pets play in our lives, especially as they accompany us into our later years.

item.title: Bake and Make Up Presents a Feel Good Recipe for Relationships
item.description: Bake and Make Up features a once inseparable twosome – childhood friends, past loves, long-lost family – and brings them together again in the Bake & Make Up kitchen where they are given a chance to reunite through a culinary journey.

item.title: A User’s Guide to Cheating Death: The Second Time Around
item.description: How far will we go to live longer? Health law expert Timothy Caulfield hosts an eye-opening second season of A User's Guide to Cheating Death on Joytv.

item.title: Preserving the Future: An MZTV Talk with MIT’s Peter B Kaufman
item.description: Moses Znaimer, founder and CEO of ZoomerMedia Limited and the MZTV Museum of Television, talks with MIT Professor and author Peter B. Kaufman on preservation, archives, truth, and media’s shifting role in the digital age.
